AUTOSAR AP R25-11
[SWS_DM_02132] Reporting DM access control denied to IdsM
Upstream requirements:
RS_Ids_00810
⌈
If a process interacts with ara:diag, and access restrictions apply, the DM shall report
a security event SEV_ACCESS_CONTROL_DM_IAM_DENIED to IdsM (see [26] and
table [SWS_DM_02133]) with the context data given in [SWS_DM_02133].
⌋
